interactive.rationale: Three presets plus a free textarea and Sanitize & render produce live rendered and serialized output from the native sanitizer.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index card promises stripping of scripts, handlers and javascript: hrefs while keeping safe markup, which is exactly what the page does.

edge_cases.rationale: Strip log now diffs an inert <template> parse of the input against the sanitized DOM: plain text 'one = 1' reports 'Nothing removed'; tricky preset correctly lists comment node, style attribute, svg script, img, javascript: URL, details/summary. 'check browser version' copy removed; the misleading 'Comment nodes survive' preset comment corrected.

telemetry_health.rationale: Only shared runtime/console capture; no assertion that setHTML actually removed the payload.

accessibility.rationale: Strip log is now a polite role=status region; panel labels are still plain divs not associated with their regions.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: 0px overflow both classes; preset and sanitize buttons min-height 44px.

openQuestions.title: Show Document.parseHTML and setHTMLUnsafe contrast
openQuestions.detail: Spec surfaces Document.parseHTML (sanitized, inspect-before-insert) and setHTMLUnsafe/parseHTMLUnsafe (opt-in, still configurable); a concept comparing them shows the safe/unsafe split and why unsafe elements can't be re-allowed through setHTML.

guidanceConsulted.query: sanitize untrusted HTML with setHTML Sanitizer config
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use setHTML() with a Sanitizer config of the current shape (elements, attributes, replaceWithChildrenElements); elements not in `elements` are removed together with their content; list wrappers whose text you want in replaceWithChildrenElements; custom configs can only restrict the safe default.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied — native setHTML default sanitizer unchanged; support note no longer blames browser version without context (states shipping browsers instead).

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible single-select card group radio keyboard
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Prefer native <button> over div+role; native elements need no Enter/Space handlers; expose toggle state with aria-pressed; announce changing results via a polite live region.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied — strip log exposed as a polite live region; existing controls already native buttons.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Prefer textContent over innerHTML for text; use setHTML() for untrusted HTML; never interpolate untrusted strings into innerHTML.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied — log entries built with createElement + textContent (no innerHTML interpolation), input parsed in an inert <template> for the diff.

summary: Goal-setting fix 2026-11-08: the strip log no longer parses its own '<script>' label as markup (textContent), and is derived from a DOM diff so benign text is not flagged and no 'check browser version' copy remains; a11y-fixer pollution removed from the XSS payload. Remaining: panel labels not associated with regions; parsehtml-vs-unsafe concept unbuilt.
